Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — Issue #⁠246612 is a real leftover:⁠ five empty `div.ad-slot-root` gpt containers reserve 250px of blank space each on www⁠.ilfoglio.it because the ad scripts are already blocked. The proposed rule `ilfoglio.it##.ad-slot-root` was applied and removed all ad reservation with the page intact, but the vision review refused it for blank regions that measured checks prove are unloaded lazy article photos and a first-party "IL FOGLIO ON AIR" promo, not ad space, so it reaches a human unverified.

## Still visible after the rule

- Bottom viewport, over the three-teaser row beneath the Trump/Ukraine lead story — Floating dark 'IL FOGLIO ON AIR' / 'Il Foglio, ora anche video.' promotional banner with an ON AIR badge and a 'VAI AL PALINSESTO' button overlays article text at the bottom of the viewport; it is a visible special-banner/ad overlay, not blank space.
- Right-hand column below the article 'L’elzeviro di Fini:⁠ “La sinistra che festeggia per Trump, poi perde in Italia. È rimasta yankee go home”' — Large empty white reserved advertising region occupying the right column from below the Fini article to the bottom of the tile; no creative, ad label, frame, or placeholder block is visible inside it.
- Le false minacce sugli aerei ci ricordano che sulla cybersicurezza la politica non si può più dividere / Tajani:⁠ "Diffusi i miei dati personali sul dark web" — Large empty white reserved ad-slot region above this article teaser; no ad creative, label, frame, iframe, or placeholder block is visible inside it.
- L’ex presidente della Republika Srpska a Mar-a-Lago — right-hand side of the lead image — Large reserved white rectangle beside the Dodik article image; no ad creative, REKLAMA label, frame, or placeholder is rendered in it, consistent with an empty leftover ad slot.
- La notizia che non c’è:⁠ i cattolici non hanno votato Trump / I prossimi regali di Trump ai dem — right-hand column — Tall blank white column to the right of the bottom article list; no ad creative, label, frame, or placeholder is visible, consistent with leftover empty ad-slot area.
- and 1 more of the same, in the run artifacts

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Missing information

- Full-page capture does not trigger loading="lazy" article images, so the vision review reads their reserved boxes as leftover ad space: On www⁠.ilfoglio.it (1920x19961 page) 45 of 46 article images carry loading="lazy". In the live session only 6 image requests were made (artifact:⁠har:⁠76e31611-af1f-42a3-bc1b-2b7a5eec37bd), and evaluate_js reports 40 lazy <⁠img⁠> elements not yet loaded reserving \~14,656 px of box height, none of them inside an ad slot; 39 of the 46 images were also incomplete at the time of the first full-page capture. The apply_rule full-page tiles therefore show large white rectangles in article columns, and both vision reviews classified them as "large empty white reserved ad regions" (and once as "non-target rendering damage"). Scrolling the page in interact_page reduces the incomplete count only slightly, and the tiled capture itself never forces those images to load. What is missing is a capture mode (or a required reveal step) that forces lazy resources to load before the full-page capture, so a "blank space" that is really an unloaded article photo is not scored as an ad leftover or as page damage.
